title: Character directions (4 / 8)
description: The same character facing 4 or 8 directions, from a saved character reference, as frames, a sprite sheet and a JSON atlas. FLUX.2 Klein 4B reference editing; max uses Qwen-Image-Edit 2511.
prompt_guide: Needs `character` (create one with the character profile or create_character). The prompt is optional extra guidance ('keep the sword in the right hand').

max.description: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (20B, int8) for the closest likeness between views - slower

param_help.model: diffusion model file (the preset normally picks it)
param_help.steps: sampling steps (the distilled models are made for 4 / 8)
param_help.candidates: takes generated in one batch; the best match to the prompt that passes the checks is kept
param_help.frame_candidates: takes per frame; the one most like the character reference is kept
param_help.directions: 4 (down, right, up, left) or 8 (plus the diagonals)
param_help.mirror: make the left-facing views by mirroring the right-facing ones (consistent, half the work; turn off for asymmetric characters)
param_help.cell: frame size in pixels for the sheet (square)
param_help.remove_background: cut the subject out with BiRefNet (transparent PNG)
param_help.defringe: re-colour soft edges so no grey halo shows on dark backgrounds
param_help.size: output canvas in pixels (square); null keeps the tight crop at full resolution
param_help.padding: empty margin around the sprite, as a share of the canvas
param_help.anchor: center, or bottom (feet on the ground line - characters and animation frames)
param_help.background: what the model is told to put behind the subject; plain and light makes the cut-out cleanest
param_help.rank_by_clip: rank the takes by how well they match the prompt (CLIP)
param_help.keep_candidates: keep every take in .spriteforge/<name>/ next to the result
param_help.fps: playback speed written into the atlas
param_help.pixel_grid: make the frames pixel art: the tallest frame's height in real pixels (e.g. 32 or 48); null = normal sprites
param_help.pixel_colors: pixel sheets: size of the ONE palette shared by every frame
param_help.pixel_palette: pixel sheets: a named palette (pico8, gameboy, nes, endesga32, sweetie16), a list of hex colours, or 'project' (the game palette)
param_help.pixel_outline: pixel sheets: add a 1-pixel dark outline to every frame
param_help.normal_map: also write <name>_normal.png (2D lighting: Godot CanvasTexture, Unity 2D lights) and a lit preview
param_help.normal_strength: how pronounced the relief of the normal map is (0.5 subtle - 2 strong)
param_help.normal_y: up = OpenGL convention, green points up (Godot, Unity); down = DirectX
